about: A SHADER layer's glint (r408, r427, format 17): r407's beach sea alone, glinting as the animation lab drew it, zoomed in on so the water fills the still. The glint is sparse by design (Simon on r407: 'super aggressive'), so a reader that left it out moves a still by under 1/255 on the mean: pixelsOff gates it, a missing glint moving 0.13% to 0.6% of a still by over 32 (tools/r427-glint/strength.sh). Written by core/test-data/anim/make_round.py. Read by shots/.../ParallaxShots, engines/godot/tests/shots.gd and engines/jme's JmeParallaxShots.

scenes.name: glint-after-wave
scenes.about: the sea through WAVE with a glint of 0.5: the painted crests lit in pieces that fade in place, in a sun's column in the view's middle; the pieces are whole turns over the effect's period, which a glinting layer takes as FOG's (8 wavelengths across, 10 up), so they run on across the sea's wrap

scenes.name: glint-after-fog
scenes.about: the same sea through FOG (0.15) with the same glint: the glint comes after the effect, before the page's fog

scenes.name: glint-after-swell
scenes.about: r431: the same sea through SWELL at the animation lab's numbers (amplitude 0.12, wavelength 1.25, speed 0.3), its look in the lab's SWELL + GLINT: the crests bent by two crossing travelling waves, the glint read where the swell moved them. The painted water is soft: plain, it is 1.35 / 255 off its swell on the mean, so pixelsOff gates it here; the shaders round's s09 and s10 gate SWELL by the mean

scenes.name: no-glint-after-glint
scenes.about: r469: g01's sea twice through WAVE, glinting behind and not glinting in front, over it: no crest is lit. libGDX's layers share one WAVE program, which sets u_glint for a layer that does not glint only when the program's last was not 0; leaving the back layer's glint on the front one lights the front's crests

scenes.name: glint-after-mirror
scenes.about: r455: the same sea through MIRROR at Simon's r419 numbers (SWELL 0.12, 1.25, 0.35), its horizon at the strip's 84 of 384 rows, mirroring the beach page's sky: its glint's sun is MIRROR's own, at a quarter of the view and 0.45 wide (Simon on r455: his numbers on MIRROR only), every other effect keeping the shipped 0.5 and 0.3

scenes.name: detail-medium-glint-in-swells-sun
scenes.about: r464: g05's sea at detail MEDIUM: drawn through SWELL, its glint kept, in SWELL's sun (GLINT_SUN_*, 0.5 and 0.3 wide: Simon on r464), not MIRROR's

scenes.name: detail-medium-no-glint
scenes.about: r464: g05's sea at MEDIUM, every layer's glint from HIGH only (setLayerDefaultDetail): SWELL without its glint. A reader that ignores the rule draws g06
